plantedBugs.description: No rate limiting — brute force password attacks possible. Should have IP-based or account-based rate limiting.
No input validation on email format or password length — could pass malformed data to bcrypt or DB.
Token has no expiry — infinite lifetime JWT is a security risk if leaked.
Error message reveals existence of account via timing — bcryptCompare on non-existent user would be faster than on existing user. Should use constant-time comparison.
